description: The price in whole credits of running a ready search for `leads` leads (or of continuing a finished one for `leads` more): a low-high range; the start holds the high figure and charges what it really spends. Also the available balance. Show the price to the user and get a yes before run_search / continue_search, passing credits_high as confirm_credits. Free, changes nothing. [REST: GET /api/tasks/{id} (estimate.credits_by_target)]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: quote_search
title: Price of a search run
